dedupe_keys.name: cream a component level coffeemaker electrical activity measurement dataset

description: CREAM, a component level coffeemaker electrical activity measurement dataset is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Daniel Jorde et al. Monitoring the internal conditions of a machine is used to increase its production efficiency and to reduce energy waste. Non-intrusive condition monitoring techniques, such as analysing electrical signals, provide insights by disaggregating a composite signal of a machine as a whole into the individual components to determine their states. Coverage: not stated; published in 2020. Formats: HDF5, TXT. The data are held in Kaggle and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
